name: Skillz
author: Tanveer Riaz
tagline: Reusable AI-agent skills for builders who ship.
description: A public marketplace of practical Agent Skills that help AI coding agents move from prompt chaos to repeatable execution across coding, debugging, architecture, security, deployment, documentation, product, and enterprise delivery.

skills.name: agent-change-workflow
skills.description: Discovery-first workflow for changing existing code: search before writing, analyze impact in plain language, gate risky changes behind approval, then execute in small commits.

skills.name: agent-handoff
skills.description: Produce a self-contained handoff note so the next agent or person can resume work without re-reading the codebase.

skills.name: agent-memory-file
skills.description: Set up and maintain a project's AI-agent memory file (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules) with durable, concise, secret-free project context.

skills.name: ai-code-review
skills.description: Review a change for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability with severity-tagged findings and concrete fixes.

skills.name: api-service-pattern
skills.description: Clean backend layering: thin route handler, service layer, repository for data access, with validation, consistent errors, and dependency injection.

skills.name: x-twitter-scraper
skills.description: Source-backed Xquik integration guidance for X search, user lookup, follower export, media download, monitors, webhooks, MCP setup, and approval-gated posting workflows.

skills.name: bug-root-cause-analysis
skills.description: Disciplined reproduce -> isolate -> diagnose -> fix -> validate loop so the real cause is fixed and the fix is proven before closing.

skills.name: change-log-release-notes
skills.description: Maintain a daily change journal during development and generate user-readable release notes derived only from those logs.

skills.name: docs-organization
skills.description: Keep all documentation in a single categorized /docs tree, prevent stray markdown and SQL files, and keep the project root minimal.

skills.name: enterprise-delivery-tracker
skills.description: Generalized, organization-agnostic structure for multi-team programme delivery: intake, prioritization, RAID, status reports, and governance updates.

skills.name: founder-validation-loop
skills.description: Turn experiments into validated, reusable assets via a tight hypothesis -> cheapest test -> signal -> decide -> capture loop.

skills.name: git-release-hygiene
skills.description: Safe Git workflow: working-branch-only policy, conventional commits, and an explicit-approval gate before any merge to main or production deploy.

skills.name: input-validation-prompt-safety
skills.description: Validate external input before use, allowlist commands and senders, and harden LLM prompts against injection so untrusted input cannot break logic or hijack an agent.

skills.name: lean-project-structure
skills.description: Scaffold or untangle a project into a lean, single-responsibility layout with clear layer boundaries and a no-unnecessary-files rule.

skills.name: llm-eval-golden-set
skills.description: Build a small golden set of inputs with expected qualities and a repeatable eval script to measure LLM-feature quality and catch regressions.

skills.name: llm-prompt-design
skills.description: Centralize LLM prompts, separate role/tone from structure from per-call context, and apply anti-AI-slop rules for human-sounding, maintainable output.

skills.name: local-first-ai-automation
skills.description: Build personal automations on a local LLM and browser automation with allowlisted triggers, no destructive actions, and graceful timeouts.

skills.name: prd-to-build-plan
skills.description: Convert a product idea or PRD into a phased, buildable plan with goals, non-goals, scope, milestones, and acceptance criteria.

skills.name: public-repo-safety-scan
skills.description: Scan staged changes and the working tree for secrets, private URLs, internal IPs, personal data, and client references before a repo goes public.

skills.name: railway-deployment-check
skills.description: Verify runtime files, env vars, and start command for managed-platform deploys (Railway, Render, Fly.io), favor auto-detection, and plan rollback.

skills.name: repo-readiness-review
skills.description: Run a readiness pass over a repo (safety, structure, docs, dependencies, runnability) and return a go / fix-first verdict with a prioritized punch list.

skills.name: resilient-batch-processing
skills.description: Process many files or records so one bad item never stops the run: isolate failures, log with identifiers, clean up temp files, and summarize results and errors.

skills.name: saas-mvp-planner
skills.description: Shape a SaaS idea into a buildable MVP: one core user, one problem, the smallest valuable solution, a happy-path journey, and an explicit not-now list.

skills.name: safe-ui-enhancement
skills.description: Restyle an existing UI without breaking it: read the brand reference, map JS/auth hooks, propose changes before editing, and verify responsive + accessibility.

skills.name: secure-env-setup
skills.description: Environment-variable-driven config with a placeholder-only .env.example and startup validation, so no secret is ever hardcoded or committed.

skills.name: supabase-data-design
skills.description: Design Postgres/Supabase-style schemas with consistent naming, row-level security by default, sensible indexes, and a clear tables-vs-JSON decision.

skills.name: think-before-coding
skills.description: Evaluate at least three distinct solution approaches with brief trade-offs before implementing, so the chosen design fits the existing codebase.
